response.sql: WITH acct AS (SELECT t.account_id, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amt FROM trans t GROUP BY t.account_id), reg AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(a.avg_amt) AS region_figure FROM acct a JOIN account ac ON ac.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = ac.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(region_figure) AS overall_avg FROM reg) SELECT r.region, r.region_figure, r.region_figure - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_average, r.region_figure / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_average FROM reg r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.region_figure > o.overall_avg
